item.summary: ​Shri Dilip Kumar, Secretary, Department of Land Resources (DoLR), Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, visited Odisha to review the progress and ground-level implementation of the Watershed Development Component of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana 2.0 (WDC-PMKSY 2.0) and the World Bank-assisted Rejuvenating Watersheds for Agricultural Resilience through Innovative…
item.title: Secretary, DoLR Reviews Implementation of WDC-PMKSY 2.0 and World Bank-Assisted REWARD Programme in Odisha
